description:
Figmore is a duo consisting of singer/musician JUICEB☮X and producer/musician 10.4 Rog – joining forces to forge their own blend of indie psych R&B.

'Jumbo Street' is their debut album, following up on their self-released 3 track EP from 2019 (which has been remastered and included here as tracks #12-14).


Vocals, guitar, trumpet, percussion and lyrics by JUICEB☮X
All other instruments and music by 10.4 Rog

"Goosebumps" features Marc Merza on guitar

All songs written by:
Joshua Braunstein (Ellen DeGenreless Music, BMI)
& Roger David Habon (Class Project Productions, BMI)

Produced & Mixed by 10.4 Rog

Mastered by Kelly Hibbert at Almachrome

Cover Illustration by Nicolina Pierre-Jacques
Design & Layout by Tawfiq Mardini

Executive Producers: Figmore & Kenny / Fresh Selects

Management: Warsame Warsame & J. Pinder for PLZCOMEAGAIN

FSX-047 © 2021 Fresh Selects.
